title: VHAL
description: Vehicle HAL: property IDs, change modes, areas, AIDL interface, subscription and debugging.

questions.question: Since which Android version is the AIDL Vehicle HAL interface available?
questions.explanation: Before Android 13, the VHAL used HIDL (android.hardware.automotive.vehicle@2.0).

questions.question: Which parts are combined (bitwise OR) to form a vehicle property ID?
questions.explanation: ID = VehiclePropertyGroup | VehicleArea | VehiclePropertyType | unique 16-bit ID. Change mode is in the config.

questions.question: Which change modes exist for vehicle properties?
questions.explanation: STATIC never changes (e.g. INFO_VIN), ON_CHANGE on value change, CONTINUOUS sampled at a rate.

questions.question: What is the change mode of PERF_VEHICLE_SPEED?
questions.explanation: Speed is sampled; subscribers set a rate between minSampleRate and maxSampleRate.

questions.question: Which value marks a vendor-specific property ID?
questions.explanation: Vendor properties need their own permissions handling in CarService (vendor permissions).

questions.question: Which area types does the VHAL define?
questions.explanation: Further types: MIRROR, DOOR, WHEEL (and VENDOR since Android 14).

questions.question: Which area type does HVAC_TEMPERATURE_SET typically use?
questions.explanation: Each areaId is a combination of VehicleAreaSeat flags describing the HVAC zone, e.g. ROW_1_LEFT.

questions.question: Who communicates with the VHAL directly?

answers.text: Any app with the CAR_SPEED permission

questions.explanation: Apps use android.car APIs; CarService maps permissions and forwards requests to the VHAL.

questions.question: In the AIDL VHAL, how is the result of setValues() reported?

answers.text: Asynchronously via IVehicleCallback.onSetValues with the request ID

questions.explanation: onSetValues reports whether the request was accepted; the new value arrives later via onPropertyEvent.

questions.question: Which fields are part of VehiclePropConfig?
questions.explanation: Permissions are mapped in CarService, not in the VHAL config.

questions.question: Which values can VehiclePropValue.status have?
questions.explanation: UNAVAILABLE e.g. when a feature is temporarily off; ERROR when reading failed.

questions.question: Where is the AIDL reference VHAL with the emulated 'FakeVehicleHardware' located in AOSP?
questions.explanation: The default implementation emulates vehicle data and is used e.g. on the emulator and Cuttlefish.

questions.question: How does the AIDL VHAL handle large payloads, e.g. many property configs?

answers.text: LargeParcelable, which can switch to shared memory
It splits them into 64 KB HIDL messages

questions.explanation: This avoids Binder transaction size limits (about 1 MB per process buffer).

questions.question: How can you inspect the VHAL on a device?
questions.explanation: dumpsys on the VHAL supports options like --list, --get and --set for debugging (implementation-dependent).

questions.question: What is the value type of GEAR_SELECTION?
questions.explanation: Values are VehicleGear constants such as GEAR_PARK, GEAR_DRIVE, GEAR_REVERSE.

questions.question: Which access modes can a property have?
questions.explanation: Access can also differ per area in newer versions (areaConfig access).

questions.question: What does a subscriber need to provide for a CONTINUOUS property?

answers.text: A sample rate within the property's min/max sample rate
Nothing; it gets every hardware update

questions.explanation: The VHAL then sends property events at about that rate.

questions.question: Which property type allows several values of different types in one property?
questions.explanation: MIXED is common for vendor properties that pack ints, floats and strings together.

questions.question: Which user-management properties let the VHAL take part in user switching?
questions.explanation: CarService asks the VHAL which user to boot into and informs it about switches (also CREATE_USER, REMOVE_USER).

questions.question: A set request was accepted, but the hardware applied a different value. What should the VHAL send?

answers.text: A property event with the actual value
Nothing; the requested value is assumed
An error for the set request

questions.explanation: Clients must not assume the set value is applied; the current value comes via onPropertyEvent.
